key_points.text: In this episode, I speak with Anane Kapila, founder and CEO of QFX, a 24.7 centralized perpetual futures exchange for traditional financial markets.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, I speak with Anane Kapila, founder and CEO of QFX, a 24.7 centralized perpetual futures exchange for traditional financial markets.

key_points.text: Before founding QFX, Anane worked at flow traders and tower research.
key_points.evidence_quote: Before founding QFX, Anane worked at flow traders and tower research, where he was introduced to high frequency trading and market microstructure in both crypto and traditional markets.

positions.commentary: The speaker uses Tesla as a hypothetical example of a fundamental price move occurring over the weekend to illustrate the risks of narrow price bands.

thesis: The episode uses a hypothetical Tesla price move to illustrate the risks of narrow price bands in perpetual futures, arguing that these instruments can experience significant fundamental price shifts outside of standard trading hours.
